description: MainActivity class for an Android application using Jetpack Compose, managing lifecycle events, permission requests, and service start-up logic.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity of the app handling lifecycle, permissions, and UI setup.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets up UI, permissions, and launches coroutines for state collection.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets the app foreground state to true in the view model.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Sets the app foreground state to false in the view model.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received by the activity, updating intent data and processing assistant launch requests.

methods.name: handleAssistantIntent
methods.description: Parses and handles assistant launch intents.
